info.name: Ecommerce API - Auth
info.description:
Authentication requests for the ecommerce API. Use a local test database because the collection creates test customers.

Set baseUrl to the running API origin, without a trailing slash. The default is http://localhost:8000.

Run the Auth folder in order with one iteration. Allow about 60 seconds after recent login requests or before repeating the run so the per-IP limit can reset.

When sending requests individually, start with Successful Auth Flows. Some error cases reuse its email or tokens. The expired-token check is optional and requires an expiredToken value.

Assertions check the intended behavior. Some checks may fail on the current backend while the fixes for password validation, token transport, and token response caching are pending.

item.name: Products & Categories
item.description: Run this folder in order against a local test database with the updated inventory service. Set productsAdminToken to a valid administrator JWT. Use the repository root as the Postman working directory and select postman/fixtures/product.png or not-an-image.txt if prompted. The run creates test data.

exec: pm.test("The paginated category list uses top-level data, links and meta", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(body.links).to.be.an("object"); pm.expect(body.meta).to.be.an("object"); });

exec: pm.test("Page size, category and next link are correct", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.meta.total).to.equal(2); pm.expect(body.meta.per_page).to.equal(1); pm.expect(body.data).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(String(body.data[0].category.id)).to.equal(String(pm.collectionVariables.get("productsCategoryId"))); pm.expect(body.links.next).to.include("category_id=" + pm.collectionVariables.get("productsCategoryId")).and.to.include("per_page=1"); });

pm.test("Page two retains the category and size", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.meta.current_page).to.equal(2); pm.expect(body.meta.total).to.equal(2); pm.expect(body.meta.per_page).to.equal(1); pm.expect(body.data).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(String(body.data[0].category.id)).to.equal(String(pm.collectionVariables.get("productsCategoryId"))); });
